test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the incorrectly spelt word.

Diplomats believe that buraucratic delays are inevitable.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. bureaucratic.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in the sentence is "**buraucratic**."
 
• The correct spelling is "**bureaucratic**," which means relating to the business of running an organization, or government.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **bureaucratic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inivitable**: This is a misspelling. The correct spelling is "inevitable," meaning certain to happen; unavoidable. 
 
• **Burocratic**: This is a misspelling. The correct word, as identified, is "bureaucratic."
 
• **Beleave**: This is a misspelling. The correct spelling is "believe," meaning accept (something) as true; feel sure of the truth of.
